# Cover Letter Agent

Use previous covers letter, resume and details of your experience to generate a cover letter.

Input the job description via the GitHub Action, and the LLM has access to my experience and cover letter writing style via S3 bucket.

Cover letter is generate and sent to my email for review and refinment.

The S3 bucket holds:
1. Resume
2. Past Cover Letter
3. Expanded details of my experience not mentioned in the resume and/or cover letter

**If you are a potential employer reading this**: Do not worry, I review and refine all cover letters generated by the LLM before sending to you :)
How good is automating a repetitive task.
